lots.title: 25112 Library Services Engage, Design and Fit out Contract - Ely Library
lots.description: Single-lot contract to engage with Cambridgeshire County Council's Library team and stakeholders, produce design options covering furniture, waypoints and signage for Ely Library, and deliver the fit-out and supply of furniture. The procurement is explicitly not split into lots (§1.7.1). Bidders are not required to produce a final design at tender stage; the successful supplier produces the final design post-award. Contract term: 6 months from 7 July 2026 with a potential 6-month extension, followed by a 12-month defects period. Estimated value: £150,000 excl. VAT / £180,000 incl. VAT. Detailed product and service requirements reside in Appendix 4 Specification, which is a separate attachment on ProContract and is not contained in this ITT markdown.
requirements: Engage with the Library team and other stakeholders to understand needs and intended outcomes of the redevelopment (§1.4.1).
Create final design options and approaches covering furniture, waypoints and signage (§1.4.2).
Deliver the design that the Authority selects, with the bidder supplying and fitting out the furniture (§1.4.1, Appendix Three §3.3).
Maintain a 12-month defects period following final handover and sign-off (§1.5.3).
Register on the Find a Tender service / Central Digital Platform before contract signature and provide the Unique Identifier (§5.5).
Register on the Match My Project (MMP) portal as a minimum social value requirement and agree a social value offering with the Authority after award (§3.4).
Sign up to the Cambridgeshire County Council Climate Charter (§4.3.1, Appendix One pass/fail 3.6).
Public Liability insurance with a limit of indemnity of not less than £5,000,000 per claim/series of claims (§4.5.1(a)).
Employer's Liability insurance with a limit of indemnity of not less than £5,000,000 per claim/series of claims (§4.5.1(b)).
Professional Indemnity insurance with a limit of indemnity of not less than £2,000,000 per claim and in the aggregate per insurance period (§4.5.1(c)).
Product Liability insurance with a limit of indemnity of not less than £1,000,000 per claim/series of claims (§4.5.1(d)).
Hold the tender open for acceptance for 180 days from the submission closing date (§2.8.1).
Submit the tender via ProContract by 12:00 noon on 22 May 2026; late submissions may be excluded (timetable §2.3, §2.10).
Comply with UK GDPR by excluding personal information from responses except referees (§2.10).

Detailed product, service and exit-planning requirements are set out in Appendix 4 Specification, which is referenced in §1.4.3 and §4.2.2 but is not contained within this ITT markdown and must be read from the ProContract attachment.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Price is weighted at 50% of the total tender score. Scored on the Most Advantageous Tender (MAT) methodology: the lowest overall compliant price receives the full 50% weighting, with other bids scored using the formula 50 - ((bidPrice - lowestPrice)/bidPrice)*100. Negative scores are floored to zero. Only the totals in cells D13 and J21 of the Appendix 3a pricing worksheet (Comprehensive Price list) are used for the price evaluation; other items priced are binding on the bidder but excluded from scoring.

The ITT document body does not quote CPV codes. The CPV codes included on the single lot (39155000-3 Library furniture; 79932000-6 Interior design services) were carried in from the upstream contract notice metadata rather than cited from the tender document itself; treat as inferred rather than document-grounded.

The technical_standards entries are regulatory / procedural frameworks (Procurement Act 2023, FOIA, EIR, UK GDPR, TUPE, Climate Charter, MMP). This ITT does not cite any product-level technical standards (BS, EN, ISO, fire-rating, accessibility) for library furniture; such standards are expected to appear in Appendix 4 Specification.
